vol_rle_intersect — 3D rle_region op

• Data kinds: rle_region × rle_region → rle_region

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.vol_rle_intersect(a, b) (to call the implementation directly, import volregion; volregion.vol_rle_intersect(a, b); from the registry, ops3d.get("vol_rle_intersect"))

Usage

Intersection of two RLE regions on the runs (no decode).

With the same sweep engine as vol_rle_union (_rle_boolean), only the intervals whose per-interval coverage state is ia & ib (inside both) are kept as runs. The cost is O(n log n) in the number of runs and does not depend on the voxel count.

Returns: a new VolRLE with the same shape. If there is no common part, a region with 0 runs (not an error. Check emptiness with len(region) == 0 or vol_rle_volume). vol_rle_decode(result) == decode(a) & decode(b) holds voxel by voxel.

Validation (ValueError): either one is not a VolRLE or fails the run-array consistency check / a.shape != b.shape.

Where to use it: overlap tests between an ROI (a domain mask passed through vol_rle_encode) and components (vol_rle_components), the common region of 2 threshold results, and IoU computation combined with vol_rle_volume (|a∩b| / |a∪b|), all without a dense array.
